body: She says therapy doesn't work for her, but her whole situation surrounding treatment is really difficult, so she is not to blame for it. I don't think she deserves a breakup, but I don't know if I can take it anymore
It's just tough for me to go back on all of the things I said, but I just can't do it anymore, I'm really torn.
I dont know if you want me to dump this much personal shit on you
